notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]That’s right - we’re playing FoMO live on HARD mode.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to see what the game is really like, now’s the time.[/p][p]Dark environments, constant tension, brutal choices, and monsters lurking around every corner.[/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ July 24 at 8 PM (GMT-3), Live here on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Come suffer with us.[/p][p]FoMO Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 now live
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released Update 1.0.1, addressing several issues reported after launch:[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed:[/p][list][*][p]Dying right after completing the sword caused it to malfunction.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking the exit door of the final maze repeatedly and too quickly could block item interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]In one of the dreams, climbing on certain boxes could prevent the player from moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Some text spacing adjustments were made.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]As you play FoMO, if you encounter any bugs, issues, or simply want to share feedback with us, please let us know in the Steam discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]See you all again soon — we hope you’re enjoying the game![/p][p][/p][p]FoMO Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: FoMO Release Date
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The wait is almost over. We’re ready.
On [b]July 21st[/b], FoMO will be fully released on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ve seen a glimpse in the demo.
Now it’s time to face everything the game has to offer:[/p][p][/p][p]✅ First-person psychological horror
✅ Random mazes, no memorizing the way out
✅ Choices that shift the narrative
✅ Retro visuals with a dystopian vibe
✅ Hard mode for those who enjoy the pain
✅ Polished UI, new objectives, and more interactions
✅ 20+ achievements
✅ Full support for PT-BR and EN
✅ And yes: we’re kicking off with several livestreams so you can see even more[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/51442607422a4d979977bf9b94fa059c77787f1b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/ad0b5e0e6b51de89004ef7d0d829374628a7f553.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/08559cf2a77a5d08a2e3ddaa3c3f20cfe3193ce3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/052faf39b24a1dd3647645ebd4daa3a810ef1505.png"][/img][/p][p]See you soon,[/p][p]FoMO Dev Team.[/p]

notes.title: 20+ Achievements to Challenge You
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]If you’re the kind of player who goes for 100%, this one’s for you:[/p][h3]FoMO will launch with over 20 achievements.[/h3][p]
Some are straightforward.
Others will push you to explore every corner.
And a few… you won’t even notice until it’s too late.[/p][p]
Tell us:
Are you team “100% everything” or “just keep going”?[/p][p][/p][p]Until next,[/p][p]FoMO Dev Team.[/p]

notes.title: The new DEMO is now available
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

[h3]The new version of the FoMO DEMO is live.[/h3]

We’ve rebuilt the DEMO to seriously upgrade the experience. We want to give you a glimpse of what FoMO does best!

Here’s what you’ll find in the new DEMO:
✅A clearer, more intuitive interaction UI — for both the environment and NPCs.
✅An objective checklist so you won’t get lost.
✅A bigger, more intense, and more challenging labyrinth.
✅Packed environments with new content and interactions — less empty space, more immersion.
✅Play the DEMO in either Portuguese (BR) or English right from the start.

FoMO is going to be: tense, claustrophobic, and full of hidden details.

[h3]Play now and let us know what you think.[/h3]

notes.title: FoMO will be available in Portuguese and English
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

Here’s a nice update:
You’ll be able to play FoMO in Portuguese (BR) or English 🌍

But we want to do even better. So, let us know:

❓Which other language would you like to see in FoMO?
We want to hear you and understand what to prioritize for the game.

Until next,
FoMO Dev Team.

notes.title: FoMO Demo 2.0 is coming
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

When we joined Steam Next Fest, we knew it was just the beginning.
We received way more feedback than expected — including some harsh, but fair. And we listened to all of it. We’ve spent the last few months obsessed with making the game tenser, sharper, and more immersive.


[h2]Here’s a spoiler of what’s changed:[/h2]

✅ The labyrinth is bigger and more challenging.
✅ We’ve enriched the environments with NPC interactions — and none of them are just small talk.
✅ Bugs: fixed.
✅ The narrative now moves at a more intense pace.
✅ Before, it was easy to get lost with no idea what to do. Now, you’ll understand where to interact and why. The UI guides the experience better, and we’ve added an objective checklist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/2cf38391ba2504efdc06d9c43bac79714843033f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/afc21e043c5427790ae25911864499fb956c3b90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708557/51442607422a4d979977bf9b94fa059c77787f1b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]📌 The new demo is coming soon!![/b][/h3]

If you played the first one, you’ll feel the difference.
If you didn’t… you might want to run.

Until next,
FoMO Dev Team.
